findings_aggregated_for_sde.desc: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] System-to-system credentials are held to the end-user baseline, not a weaker one. app/password_policy.py defines a single policy (MIN_LENGTH=12, lower/upper/digit/symbol required, plus a FORBIDDEN_PASSWORDS denylist that includes the values this project previously shipped as defaults) and validate_system_account_password delegates straight to validate_password_policy, so a service account cannot be graded against a looser rule; the docstring permits adding requirements but never removing them. app/config.py refuses to start rather than falling back: _required_secret enforces MIN_SECRET_LENGTH=32 (256 bits) on JWT_SECRET_KEY and OTP_HMAC_KEY, and _required removes the former 'chef' / 'admin' / 'password' defaults for CHEF_USERNAME and the POSTGRES_* credentials. Alternative mitigation accepted: a single shared policy module plus fail-closed configuration enforces the parity the CM requires | verdict=pass confidence=high
